[[File:SepDreadnaught-SWE.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Separatist dreadnaught [[Invincible/Legends|''Invincible'']]]]
A '''dreadnaught''' or '''dreadnought''' was normally a powerful [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]]. In the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]] it referred to any ship over 5,000 meters long<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>. In some cases, if they were large enough, they could even be listed as [[superdreadnaught]]s.<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

The term could refer to the following:
*[[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class Dreadnought]]
*[[Black Hole-class Salvage Dreadnought|''Black Hole''-class Salvage Dreadnought]]
*[[Conqueror-class atmospheric dreadnaught|''Conqueror''-class atmospheric dreadnaught]]
*[[Core Galaxy Systems Dreadnaught]]
*[[Corellian Dreadnaught]] (ship)
*[[Corellian Dreadnaughts]] (sports team)
*[[Dreadnought battle tank]]
*[[Dreadnaught cruiser]]
*[[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]]
*[[Geonosian dreadnaught]]
*[[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]]
*[[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]]
*[[Kandosii-type dreadnaught|''Kandosii''-type dreadnaught]]
*[[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Separatist dreadnaught]]
*[[Sith dreadnaught]]
*[[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]]
